scripts.build: pnpm registry:build && pnpm registry:site && pnpm --filter deskui build && pnpm llms:build && pnpm --filter @deskui/docs build
scripts.release:build: pnpm registry:build && pnpm registry:site && pnpm build:cli && pnpm llms:build && pnpm --filter @deskui/docs build
scripts.release:verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm release:build && pnpm release:check
scripts.test: pnpm skills:check && pnpm --filter @deskui/ui test && pnpm --filter deskui test && pnpm --filter @deskui/docs test
